mapper.insert: INSERT INTO heritage_experience (user_id, heritage_id, title, content, rating, location_name, longitude, latitude, image_urls, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{heritageId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{rating}, #{locationName}, #{longitude}, #{latitude}, #{imageUrls}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS user_id, heritage_id AS heritage_id, title, content, rating, location_name AS location_name, longitude, latitude, image_urls AS image_urls, create_time AS create_time, update_time AS update_time FROM heritage_experience WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT id, user_id AS user_id, heritage_id AS heritage_id, title, content, rating, location_name AS location_name, longitude, latitude, image_urls AS image_urls, create_time AS create_time, update_time AS update_time FROM heritage_experience WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
